## Summary

Describe the problem and the change made to solve it.

## Testing

List the checks you ran and their results.

## Screenshots

Include before/after screenshots for visible UI changes, or write `Not applicable`.

## Checklist

- [ ] My change is focused and does not include unrelated generated files.
- [ ] I ran the relevant Debug build and tests.
- [ ] I ran the installer build when changing packaging or runtime behavior.
- [ ] I updated documentation for user-visible or setup changes.
- [ ] I did not commit credentials, account data, `Flash.ocx`, or other secrets.
- [ ] My commits use conventional commit messages.
